title: paired-extension — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins one behavioral case for protocol::paired_extension::parse_paired_extensions_array — the canonical-JSON decoder for the paired_extensions array embedded in vault.prefs (browser-clipper persisted pairing-token registry; protocol.md §9.5.2). The decoder accepts a JSON array of PairedExtension records (extension_id, token_value, revoked, plus the additive optional paired_at u64), tolerating insignificant whitespace and unknown future keys (forward-compat) while banning JSON floats. It returns the decoded records plus the number of bytes consumed (the cursor-advance contract the embedding prefs codec relies on). The bearer token_value is serde-skipped on the IPC boundary but written explicitly by the on-disk canonical codec, so it round-trips through this decoder. Not an on-disk codec and not cryptographic by itself (the bytes are decoded only after the vault.prefs AEAD verified) — deterministic cross-client behavior. Two case kinds: 'parse_ok' (decoded set pinned as its canonical re-encoding via canonical_encode_paired_extensions — NFC folding + lexicographic key order + (extension_id, token_value)-sort; paired_at emitted only when present — plus the consumed byte count) and 'parse_fail' (the closed error surface). Rust reference: protocol/src/paired_extension.rs (main myne repository).

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'paired-extension/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped — downstream test runners may reference these strings.

oneOf.title: parse_ok — pin the decoded record-set (as its canonical re-encoding) and the consumed byte count

input_bytes_utf8_hex.description: The input bytes as exact UTF-8 (hex). A canonical JSON array, optionally followed by trailing bytes the embedding codec continues past.

expected_consumed_len.description: The exact number of input bytes the decoder MUST report as consumed (the array length, never including trailing bytes).

expected_canonical_utf8_hex.description: The canonical re-encoding (canonical_encode_paired_extensions) of the decoded record-set as exact UTF-8 bytes (hex). Captures NFC folding, lexicographic key order (extension_id < paired_at < revoked < token_value), (extension_id, token_value)-sort, the omitted-when-None byte-identity of paired_at, and unknown-field drop.

oneOf.title: parse_fail — pin the closed error surface

input_bytes_utf8_hex.description: The malformed/invalid input bytes as exact UTF-8 (hex).

expected_error.description: The PairedExtensionParseError variant the decoder MUST return: malformed (not well-formed canonical JSON / forbidden float / over-deep nesting), missing_field (a required field — extension_id / token_value / revoked — absent), wrong_type (a field present with the wrong JSON type).
